name: Google Calendar
author: Jacob Vincent-Mink
description: Adds bounded upcoming-event context from a private Google Calendar iCal address.

categories.label: Timed events
categories.description: Meetings and other events with a specific start time.

setup.summary: Paste the Secret address in iCal format from Google Calendar settings. OmaDigest stores it in Secret Service and never sends it to the digest model.

fields.label: Secret iCal address
fields.description: Google Calendar → Settings for my calendars → Integrate calendar → Secret address in iCal format.
